# Data notice

The files in this directory are aggregate results computed from the ULB credit-card fraud data
(Worldline and ULB MLG). No row-level data, predictions or model files are included.

Contains information from [Credit Card Fraud
Detection](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/mlg-ulb/creditcardfraud), which is made available here
under the [Open Database License (ODbL)](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/).

Please cite: Andrea Dal Pozzolo, Olivier Caelen, Reid A. Johnson and Gianluca Bontempi,
*Calibrating Probability with Undersampling for Unbalanced Classification*, Symposium on
Computational Intelligence and Data Mining (CIDM), IEEE, 2015.

`benchmark.json` and `benchmark.md` are the original evaluation, run on the identical OpenML 1597 v1
copy (see `source_comparison.md`). They are kept exactly as recorded. Licensing details and the
method used to derive these results: `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
